resources.string: The song that plays right now moves with small bars, on the Home tiles and in every playlist, album and search.
Tap the DJ while your TV plays and its queue is replaced, so you hear the new set next. The DJ also has its own entry in your profile menu, and its tile on Home moves while it plays.
Pull down to refresh on every list and page, not only on a few.
Each profile pairs on its own, and the DJ goes to the TV with the right account.
Many fixes: downloads keep no login token in their database, the Jukebox limits connections, the equalizer sliders behave, and lyrics keep running while playback is paused.
Android Auto and a library like the iPhone\'s
Connect your Audiobookshelf server under Settings or at sign-in and listen in the same app, with chapters, speed, a sleep timer and your progress in sync.
